versions.changelog:
Internet Conversion OS 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces a full-stack internet conversion framework covering marketing strategy, content planning, user growth, monetization, and user journey design.
- Supports 7 work modes (value definition, value packaging, attention acquisition, trust building, conversion trigger, user journey, and conversion diagnosis) plus a Full OS mode for end-to-end solutions.
- Includes detailed step-by-step workflows, formula, templates, and actionable output for each module.
- Provides diagnostic tools, benchmark data, and prioritization to identify and solve conversion bottlenecks.
- Features a user-friendly onboarding guide and industry-adaptive recommendations.
